subject.title: fix: make Back work within channel setup

question: Should the shared channel setup contract require adapters to call `beforePersistentEffect` at their first irreversible effect, thereby making channel-local Back unavailable after that boundary?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent, but the boundary determines replay, rollback, plugin-install retention, and persistence semantics across current and future setup adapters; this is an ownership and compatibility choice rather than a narrow author-side repair.

options.title: Approve the declared persistence boundary
options.body: Accept channel-scoped Back until the first adapter-declared persistent effect, then rebase and validate the exact merge result.

options.title: Narrow the shared contract first
options.body: Request a smaller adapter contract or additional owner guidance if the repository does not want persistence timing to be controlled through this shared callback.

options.title: Pause for setup ownership review
options.body: Defer landing if maintainers want the broader setup-cancellation work to define the permanent lifecycle contract first.

recommendation.title: Approve the declared persistence boundary
recommendation.body: Accept channel-scoped Back until the first adapter-declared persistent effect, then rebase and validate the exact merge result.

likelyOwner.reason: The related setup-wizard work and this branch both establish the lifecycle boundary under review.
